pageDescription: Employee records, documents, recruiting, and access in one secure workspace.

recruitingDescription: Manage applicants, evaluations, and hiring decisions.

revokeAccessItem2: Existing records and history are kept, just no longer visible to them

applicantNotFound: This applicant file could not be found.
timelineEmpty: No activity yet – appointments, contacts, interviews and emails will appear here in chronological order.
name: Name
